# CRC test vectors for the STM32F1 CRC unit (CRC-32/MPEG-2 on 32-bit words).
# Polynomial 0x04C11DB7, initial value 0xFFFFFFFF, no reflection, no final XOR.
# The data is in memory order: each 4 bytes are one little-endian word.
#
# Format: one vector on each line: <crc> <data>
#   <crc>   the expected CRC, 8 hexadecimal digits
#   <data>  the data bytes in hexadecimal; '-' is no data
# Used by tools/tests (vsl-stamp-image.py) and by the bootloader tests.
ffffffff -
df8a8a2b 78563412
c704dd7b 00000000
00000000 ffffffff
c704dd7b ffffffffffffffff
7d24a31b 78563412f0debc9a
fefc54f9 3132333435363738
b7ec66f4
